format: ATcT covariance, sparse correlation form; see README.md
sd_units: kJ/mol; sd = sqrt(API covariance diagonal), which approximates the printed ATcT 95 % uncertainty of DfH(298.15 K), TN 1.220 (median ratio 0.988)

cut.rule: pair dropped when 2|r| sd_i sd_j < tau * (sd_i^2 + sd_j^2 - 2|r| sd_i sd_j) or when r rounds to 0; r rounded so rounding changes var(x_i -/+ x_j) and the minimum over k of var(x_i - k x_j) by <= 0.5 %
